title: Fakeway
description:
Introduction 

Connection: Currently you can connect via Steam or LAN.

Combat: Including melee weapons, long-range weapons, staff summons, and other weapons. Currently, it contains 30 common monsters and 5 bosses.

 

Planting: Plant various crops. Currently there are more than 10 plants that can be planted.

Exploration: Currently includes villages, forests, dungeons, oceans and other landforms. 

 

Collection: Items dropped by monsters, collected items, mined items, and synthesized items are worth collecting. There are currently 600 items of various types. 

 

Construction: Build a camp to accommodate the arrival of NPCs. Currently, wooden houses, wooden tables, and wooden chairs can be built. 

If you like Terraria, you can try this game. It will bring you a different experience.

Roadmap

Future updates to Fakeway will continue to enhance agriculture, circuitry, automation, and online multiplayer experiences. We hope that through continuous content expansion, the game will gradually evolve into a world with deeper systems and creative space, rather than simply a pixel survival game.

We plan to develop a process with 10 bosses, and we have completed 4 so far. 

In 2026, we plan to complete the development of all game content.

In 2027, we plan to optimize the details of the entire game.

Feedback

Multiple feedback channels are available on the game homepage.

Another anonymous feedback tool is built into the game.

We appreciate the sharp criticism more than positive reviews.
description_short: A Terraria-like open-world survival sandbox! Explore a vast procedurally generated pixel world, gather resources, forge equipment, and battle monsters. Adventure solo or team up with friends online to build your own world. Endless creation and exploration, making every adventure unique.
